title: Instagrammable Sri Lanka | FREE Excursion to Mirissa
highlights: Explore Sri Lanka's rich heritage and scenic beauty in cities like Kandy, Bentota, and Colombo, each offering a unique blend of culture and landscapes.
Watch the vibrant Kandyan Dance performance, featuring traditional music, dance, and a dramatic fire-walking ritual.
Visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy, home to one of Buddhism's most important relics, attracting pilgrims from around the world.
Discover the Turtle Hatchery in Bentota, where you can learn about conservation efforts and witness the release of baby turtles into the ocean.
Take a scenic walk to Coconut Tree Hill in Mirissa, a picturesque vantage point offering stunning views of the coastline.
overview:
About the Tour:
Srilanka, is the pearl of the Indian ocean a trip to this mesmerizing island where you will get fascinated by the lush tea plantations & waterfalls, tropical beaches, jaw-dropping wildlife, historical monuments & temples.
The gateway to all of this hill-country action is Kandy and Sri Lanka’s second city and the island’s undisputed historical and cultural capital full of rich in heritage and culture of royal city Kandy. Skim the waves at speed and feel the splash against your sunkissed skin on the vast waters encompassing Bentota and participate in the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project to have a close look into the process of rescuing and nurturing sea turtles. Surf through the waves, and spend your days enjoying fresh coconuts in your hammock at Mirissa, wander at the sprawling layout and complex history featuring a fascinating heritage and enticing architectural wonders of the dutch and British era.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Transfer to Kandy
days.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be driven to Kandy. On the way, stop by the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe theme closely and even see them bathing in the river. Once in Kandy, check in to your hotel and later, set out on a scenic drive around Upper Lake. Enjoy breathtaking views of the city from Kandy View Point and visit the Kandy Lake. In the evening, witness the Kandyan Dance show, featuring a thrilling fire-walking display. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, you'll be driven for a sightseeing tour of Kandy. Begin with a visit to the vibrant Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens, Sri Lanka’s largest garden, boasting over 4,000 plant species, including rare orchids and towering royal palms. Next, visit the iconic Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that houses a revered relic of Buddha’s tooth. Also, marvel at the white Buddha at Bahirawakanda Vihara Buddha Statue and soak in the amazing views.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, check out and board the transfer to Bentota. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel & spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Bentota Beach & soak in the stunning coastal views or indulge in thrilling water activities. Also, you can visit Cinnamon Island & witness its traditional harvesting techniques. You can also witness stunning intricate stone carvings of the historic Galapata Vihara, an ancient Buddhist temple.

days.title: Day Trip to Galle and Mirissa
days.desc: Today, you'll be driven for a day trip to Galle and Mirissa. Upon arrival in Galle, visit various sites such as the Dutch Reformed Church, Galle Dutch Fort—a UNESCO World Heritage Site—and the Galle Fort Lighthouse. Also, explore the Maritime Museum and Meera Mosque before moving to Mirissa. Later, relax on the scenic Mirissa Beach and take a leisurely stroll to the Coconut Tree Hill, a popular spot known for its picturesque scenery. After a fulfilling day, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to Colombo. Once you arrive, check in at your hotel and later, get driven for a sightseeing tour. Visit the Gangaramaya Temple, one of Colombo's most historic and revered Buddhist temples. Then, see the impressive Colombo Lotus Tower, the tallest structure in South Asia, offering breathtaking panoramic views. Continue your tour and explore other sites such as the Pettah Floating Market, Galle Face Green, and more. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: This day, you'll check out from the hotel and get driven to the airport for your flight back home.
